purpose: Measure two independent changes against the current integrated production baseline
fixtureIntegrity: Locked SHA-256 required before every observation
timingBoundary: Browser monotonic file-input change through completed import UI; separate traces and memory observations are not timing evidence
failurePolicy: Retain every scheduled observation and failure; do not replace observations or trim tails
decisionPolicy: No PR from component-only gains. Require replicated useful complete-import improvement beyond identical-code controls, preserved semantics/storage, and passing existing prospective memory screen. Assess improvement against implementation complexity.
memoryPolicy: Unchanged qualification gate: all observations covered; paired median PSS/private increases at most 5%, individual pairs at most 10%
